name.description: Name of C3 Environment unique in the parent Cluster

tags.description: Tags that serve as arbitrary metadata attached to the object of a type

singleNode.description:
If true then this environment will only have a single node that will serve requests and execute jobs for every
App in this Env

minimalInfra.description: Start Env with a minimal infrastructure

defaultAppMode.description: Default app mode to optionally define {@link App#mode}.

allowTestToProd.description: Allow Apps in this env to change mode from Test to Prod, as an exception.

sharedDb.description: Only applicable for cases where Env is a singleNode Env. This flag controls whether the env will use shared instances for {@link JdbcStore} and {@link KvStore} or use a H2 disk-backed datastore for both.

waitSpec.description: Specifies various parameters for waitFor* actions.

waitForReadyInternal.description: Decision to wait for C3 App to be ready to serve background tasks or internal calls

waitForReady.description: Decision to wait for C3 App to be ready to accept external API calls

serverVersion.description: Semantic version of the server for this C3 Environment

cloudNamespace.description:
Cloud Namespace for this C3 Env; if not set then C3 Env will inherit it from C3 Cluster Leader

@see Env#configuredCloudNamespace

nodePoolConfig.description:
List of {@link App.NodePool.Config} for an environment. These {@link App.NodePool} config will get overridden
at env level upon env start. This allows configuration of {@link App.NodePool} before creation of environment.

title: Specification for starting a C3 Environment
name: Cluster.StartEnvSpec
